pick_rule:
(proposed for Lewis's approval, UNB-208):
  A. unbrowse6 coverage bank (docs/qa/benchmark-harness/bank/bank.json, 276 tasks, unbrowse6 8b7ff88):
     every task that is (1) not deferred (no login or live id needed), (2) checked by a deterministic rule only
     (regex / contains / count>=N alternatives; no judge, no numeric-needs-ground-truth, no gate), (3) passed at
     least once before (ever_passed), and (4) not expected to end at a wall (gate_expected false).
  B. Lundy nightly regression set (unbrowse-core test-banks/popular-sites/regression.json, 13 sites): one task per
     site, its search case's third (long-tail) value, scored by: at least 3 listed results that each name a
     distinctive word of the value.
  C. The staging criteria sites (Lewis, 18 Nov 2026: "unbrowse staging is performing super fast browserlessly with
     max coverage on sites like lazada carousell and ticketmaster"; added to the bank 19 Nov 2026): one search task
     per site, asking for the first 5 results with the fields the criteria name (name or title, price or date, link),
     checked by the judge reading the answer: at least 5 items of that kind, each with those fields. A check a
     pattern cannot make: on 19 Nov a rule that counted "the largest list in the reply" passed a reply whose largest
     list was the page's advertising slots.

check_fixes: 18 Nov 2026 (UNB-208, approved by Lewis 18 Nov): six checks failed answers that a hand audit found right (programme 887958 step 7, BASELINE.md section 2). Lundy searches rank by relevance, so a title need not hold the value's distinctive word: those checks now ask for the most titles that name any word of the query that the site's own first 5 results met on audit (substack 2, the rest 3). GeBIZ had one open cleaning tender, so its check asks for at least one. Each task keeps its old check in check_before_2026_11_18. A GeBIZ answer of 'none open' fails this check: re-read it by hand.
